content.value: Calculate the angular aperture for a paraboloid reflector antenna for which aperture number is (i), 0.25 and (ii) 0.50. Given. that diameter of the reflector mouth is 10 m, Calculate the position of focal point with refrence to the reflector mouth in each case.
